rows.why: Add-wallet submit through the real #lcAddForm on the isolated instance persisted a NEW wallet 0xf10f10f10f10f10f10f10f10f10f10f10f10f10f with distinct values mode=CLO, copy_mode=proportional, norm_base=250.0, fixed_notional=55.0 (config sha 615e4b59c7dc -> b3633a6b9ec1, wallet count 5 -> 6), and an invalid input was rejected with the visible error text 'BAD_WALLET' in class 'lc-status lc-bad' with the config file byte-identical (True).
